result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. Its one paragraph says the current decision is HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so internal hosts can't use plain HTTP. It also says certificate verification stays on for all builds.

The project's memory has no formal decision on internal HTTP, only two recorded user statements. An earlier one said "plain http for internal hosts", and a later one said "https everywhere, no exceptions". The later statement supersedes the earlier one, so I used it and left the plain-HTTP option out of the document. Both statements are lower-trust excerpts from session transcripts, not confirmed decisions. If you want a firmer record, you'd need to state the decision again.
